```{r}
# Load libraries

# The {"if (require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")"} - for loading and installing packages in a single command -> only need to do this once

if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")

pacman::p_load(sf, terra, tidyverse, tidyterra, colorspace, ggrepel, patchwork, tmap, trend, slider, forcats, viridis, viridisLite, scales, hexbin, ggh4x, scico, ggridges, truncnorm, zoo, cowplot, ggplotify, png, magick, ggtext, grid, elevatr, whitebox, readxl)

# DATA HANDLING#
# readxl -> for reading the .xlsx landscape data
# tidyverse -> for data manipulation, cleaning, and visualisation in a cohesive framework
# forcats -> for managing factors (categorical variables)
# slider -> for rolling or sliding window calculations
# zoo -> for working with ordered observations, especially time-series data, with irregular time steps
# elevatr   → for downloading SRTM DEM tiles automatically
# whitebox  → R bindings for WhiteboxTools hydrological processing

# SPATIAL DATA & MAPPING#
# sf -> for handling vector spatial data (points, lines, polygons)
# terra -> for handling and processing raster data
# tidyterra -> for using tidyverse tools on terra objects
# tmap -> for creating thematic maps

# VISUALISATION#
# viridis -> for perceptually uniform color palettes
# viridisLite -> same use as above though I shall use this for R^2 (Temporal Performance raster)
# scales -> for controlling plot scale formatting (e.g., number and date labels)
# hexbin -> for visualizing point density with hexagonal bins
# ggh4x -> for advanced ggplot2 features = facetted_pos_scales
# scico -> for scientific color maps
# colorspace -> for a wide variety of perceptually uniform color palettes
# ggrepel -> for preventing text labels from overlapping
# patchwork -> for combining multiple plots into one figure
# ggridges -> for creating ridge plots (joy plots)
# truncnorm -> for generating random numbers from a truncated normal distribution
# cowplot -> for arranging multiple ggplot objects and converting other plot types into ggplot-compatible objects 
# ggplotify -> for converting non-ggplot objects (like base R plots or tmap grobs) into ggplot objects
# png -> for basic reading and writing of PNG files into raw pixel arrays
# magick -> for professional-grade image processing, editing, and format conversion
# ggtext → enhanced text rendering in ggplot2 using Markdown/HTML (e.g., bold, italics, styled labels)

# STATISTICAL ANALYSIS#
#trend -> for analysing trends in time-series data = Theil-Sen slope
```

```{r}
## Data preparation
dir.create("data/processed", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create("outputs/figures", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create("outputs/tables",  showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

awf_raw <- read_excel("data/raw/awf_landscapes_raw.xlsx", sheet = "AWF_Landscapes")

awf <- awf_raw %>%
  mutate(
    Protected_pct     = parse_number(as.character(Protected_pct)),
    PopGrowth_pct     = ((Pop50_SSP2 - Pop30_SSP2) / Pop30_SSP2) * 100,
    PopDens30         = Pop30_SSP2 / Km_sq,
    ProtectionGap     = Protected_pct - KBA_pct,
    CropExpRate_ha_yr = CropExp17_25_ha / 8,
    CropNetRate_ha_yr = CropNet17_25_ha / 8,
    CropDirection     = case_when(CropNet17_25_ha > 0 ~ "Net expansion",
                                  CropNet17_25_ha < 0 ~ "Net contraction",
                                  TRUE                ~ "No change"),
    AGB_class         = cut(AGB22_MgHa,
                            breaks = quantile(AGB22_MgHa, c(0, 1/3, 2/3, 1), na.rm = TRUE),
                            labels = c("Low", "Medium", "High"),
                            include.lowest = TRUE),
    LabelShort        = str_trunc(LandscapeName, 25, side = "right")
  )

awf %>%
  summarise(
    n_landscapes       = n(),
    total_area_km2     = sum(Km_sq, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_pop_2030     = sum(Pop30_SSP2, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_natural_pct   = mean(Natural25_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_kba_pct       = mean(KBA_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_protected_pct = mean(Protected_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_agb_Mt       = sum(AGB22_Mt, na.rm = TRUE),
    net_crop_change_ha = sum(CropNet17_25_ha, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  print()

write_csv(awf, "data/processed/awf_landscapes_clean.csv")
```

```{r}
## Shared theme and palette
theme_awf <- function(base_size = 11) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) %+replace%
    theme(
      text             = element_text(colour = "grey20"),
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.2), hjust = 0,
                                      margin = margin(b = 4)),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = rel(0.85), hjust = 0,
                                      margin = margin(b = 8)),
      plot.caption     = element_text(colour = "grey55", size = rel(0.65), hjust = 0,
                                      margin = margin(t = 8)),
      plot.title.position   = "plot",
      plot.caption.position = "plot",
      panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey92"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position  = "top"
    )
}

col_kba       <- "#2C7A7B"  # teal: biodiversity value
col_protected <- "#C05621"  # burnt orange: protection coverage
col_expand    <- "#B83A2E"  # red-brown: cropland expansion
col_contract  <- "#2E7D32"  # forest green: cropland contraction
col_neutral   <- "grey70"
```

```{r}
## Plot 1: Protection gap dumbbell
d1 <- awf %>% mutate(LabelShort = fct_reorder(LabelShort, ProtectionGap, .desc = FALSE))

p1 <- ggplot(d1, aes(y = LabelShort)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = KBA_pct, xend = Protected_pct, yend = LabelShort),
               colour = col_neutral, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(x = KBA_pct, colour = "KBA share"), size = 2.8) +
  geom_point(aes(x = Protected_pct, colour = "Protected share"), size = 2.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("KBA share" = col_kba, "Protected share" = col_protected),
                      name = NULL) +
  labs(
    title    = "Protection gap: biodiversity value vs formal protection",
    subtitle = "Landscapes sorted by protection gap (protected % minus KBA %); lowest at bottom",
    x = "Share of landscape area (%)", y = NULL,
    caption  = "Sources: AWF Africa_KBA polygon asset (KBA share); World Database on Protected Areas, WDPA (protected share)."
  ) +
  theme_awf()

ggsave("outputs/figures/01_protection_gap_dumbbell.png", p1,
       width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
p1
```

```{r}
## Plot 2: Cropland dynamics diverging bar
d2 <- awf %>%
  mutate(CropNet_kha = CropNet17_25_ha / 1000,
         LabelShort  = fct_reorder(LabelShort, CropNet_kha))

p2 <- ggplot(d2, aes(x = CropNet_kha, y = LabelShort, fill = CropDirection)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(abs(CropNet_kha) < 1,
                               ifelse(abs(CropNet_kha) < 0.005, "0.00", sprintf("%+.2f", CropNet_kha)),
                               sprintf("%+.1f", CropNet_kha)),
                hjust = ifelse(CropNet_kha >= 0, -0.15, 1.15)),
            size = 2.6, colour = "grey30") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.06, 0.08))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Net expansion" = col_expand,
                               "Net contraction" = col_contract,
                               "No change" = col_neutral), name = NULL) +
  labs(
    title    = "Cropland dynamics 2017–2025",
    subtitle = "Net change in cropland area per landscape",
    x = "Net cropland change (thousands of hectares)", y = NULL,
    caption  = paste0("Source: Esri/Impact Observatory Sentinel-2 10 m LULC (2017, 2025), common-valid footprint.\n",
                      "Net change = gross expansion (non-crop 2017 → crop 2025) minus gross loss (crop 2017 → non-crop 2025).")
  ) +
  theme_awf()

ggsave("outputs/figures/02_cropland_dynamics_bar.png", p2,
       width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
p2
```

```{r}
## Plot 3: Population-nature scatter
# Most landscapes retain >90% natural cover, so the axis is stretched toward 100%
# (log scale of the *converted* share, 100 - natural). Medians/quadrants are unaffected.
trans_natural <- scales::new_transform(
  "natural_cover",
  transform = function(x) -log10(100.5 - x),
  inverse   = function(x) 100.5 - 10^(-x)
)

med_nat <- median(awf$Natural25_pct, na.rm = TRUE)
med_pop <- median(awf$PopGrowth_pct, na.rm = TRUE)

p3 <- ggplot(awf, aes(x = Natural25_pct, y = PopGrowth_pct)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = med_nat, xmax = 100, ymin = med_pop, ymax = Inf,
           fill = col_kba, alpha = 0.07) +
  annotate("text", x = 100, y = max(awf$PopGrowth_pct) * 1.04,
           label = "High natural cover, high demographic pressure",
           fontface = "italic", colour = "grey35", hjust = 1, size = 3.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = med_nat, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey55") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = med_pop, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey55") +
  geom_point(aes(size = Km_sq), colour = col_kba, alpha = 0.65) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = LabelShort), size = 2.8, colour = "grey20",
                  max.overlaps = 20, seed = 42, segment.colour = "grey70",
                  segment.size = 0.25, box.padding = 0.4, min.segment.length = 0.1) +
  scale_x_continuous(transform = trans_natural,
                     breaks = c(50, 70, 80, 90, 95, 98, 99, 100),
                     limits = c(50, 100), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.04))) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.1))) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 12, labels = comma, name = "Landscape area (km\u00b2)") +
  labs(
    title    = "Population growth vs remaining natural cover",
    subtitle = "SSP2 population growth 2030\u20132050 against natural land cover in 2025; dashed lines = medians",
    x = "Natural land cover, 2025 (% of classified area; stretched scale toward 100%)",
    y = "Projected population growth 2030\u20132050 (%)",
    caption  = paste0("Sources: Wang, Meng & Long SSP2 population projections; Esri/Impact Observatory LULC.\n",
                      "Upper-right quadrant = high natural cover under high demographic pressure.")
  ) +
  theme_awf()

ggsave("outputs/figures/03_population_nature_scatter.png", p3,
       width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
p3
```

```{r}
## Plot 4: Carbon stock x threat quadrant
med_x <- median(awf$CropPctChg17_25, na.rm = TRUE)
med_y <- median(awf$AGB22_MgHa, na.rm = TRUE)

p4 <- ggplot(awf, aes(x = CropPctChg17_25, y = AGB22_MgHa)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = med_x, xmax = Inf, ymin = med_y, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "#4A6741", alpha = 0.07) +
  annotate("text", x = max(awf$CropPctChg17_25, na.rm = TRUE),
           y = max(awf$AGB22_MgHa, na.rm = TRUE),
           label = "High carbon, high threat", fontface = "italic", colour = "grey35",
           hjust = 1, vjust = -0.3, size = 3.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = med_x, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey55") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = med_y, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey55") +
  geom_point(aes(size = AGB22_Mt), colour = "#4A6741", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = LabelShort), size = 2.6, colour = "grey20",
                  max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 42, segment.colour = "grey70",
                  segment.size = 0.25, box.padding = 0.35, point.padding = 0.15,
                  min.segment.length = 0, force = 2, max.time = 5, max.iter = 30000) +
  scale_x_continuous(transform = scales::pseudo_log_trans(sigma = 50, base = 10),
                     breaks = c(-100, -50, 0, 50, 100, 200, 400, 600)) +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = c(10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 400)) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 12, labels = comma, name = "Total AGB (Mt)") +
  labs(
    title    = "Carbon stock and cropland threat",
    subtitle = "Above-ground biomass density vs relative cropland change 2017–2025; dashed lines = medians",
    x = "Net cropland change relative to 2017 (%; pseudo-log scale)",
    y = "Mean above-ground biomass, 2022 (Mg/ha; log scale)",
    caption  = "Sources: ESA CCI Biomass v6 (2022, 100 m); Esri/Impact Observatory LULC 2017 and 2025."
  ) +
  theme_awf()

ggsave("outputs/figures/04_carbon_threat_quadrant.png", p4,
       width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
p4
```
